# Bloomreach

> Bloomreach is an agentic AI personalization platform that enables ecommerce brands to deliver hyper-personalized customer experiences across marketing automation, product discovery, and composable commerce.

Bloomreach serves 1,400+ global brands with its Loomi AI platform, which powers marketing automation across 13+ channels, intelligent product discovery, and customer data capabilities. The company combines AI-driven personalization with composable commerce solutions to help enterprises break limits in ecommerce growth and customer loyalty.

## Key Topics
